proposed.text: How may time-dependent deflection be treated when nonstructural elements are attached after some deflection has already occurred?

options.text: It must always be counted from zero with no reduction.
It may be reduced by the amount calculated to occur before attachment, based on accepted engineering data.
It is replaced by a wind-load coefficient.
It is ignored for all concrete members.

rationale.correct: The Table 424.2.2 note permits reduction by the amount of deflection calculated to occur before attachment, based on accepted engineering data.
rationale.takeaway: Attachment timing matters in post-attachment deflection checks.
